components.title: CartPole live environment
components.description: The Basic Suite environment must expose an online-RL CartPole environment.

components.title: SB3 PPO algorithm
components.description: PPO must retain its runner entrypoint, algorithm identity, and online-RL capability declaration.

components.title: d3rlpy CQL algorithm
components.description: CQL must retain its runner entrypoint, algorithm identity, and offline-RL capability declaration.

components.title: DNN model
components.description: The Basic Suite DNN must expose its architecture configuration.

components.title: Tabular data module
components.description: The data-loader adapter must remain independently configurable from a dataset environment.

cases.title: Online smoke recipe
cases.description: A minimal online-RL recipe using Basic Suite PPO, DNN, and CartPole must execute successfully.

cases.title: Missing method is blocked
cases.description: An online-RL experiment without any method must fail preflight.

cases.title: Missing agent is blocked
cases.description: Every online-RL method must declare an agent harness.
cases.blocked_reason: Online RL requires an agent harness.

cases.title: Missing model is blocked
cases.description: Every online-RL method must declare a model architecture.
cases.blocked_reason: A method without a model architecture must fail preflight.

cases.title: Offline CQL in online RL is blocked
cases.description: CQL is offline-only and must be rejected by an online-RL experiment.
cases.blocked_reason: CQL is compatible with offline RL only.

cases.title: Offline IQL in online RL is blocked
cases.description: IQL is offline-only and must be rejected by an online-RL experiment.
cases.blocked_reason: IQL is compatible with offline RL only.

cases.title: Offline TD3+BC in online RL is blocked
cases.description: TD3+BC is offline-only and must be rejected by an online-RL experiment.
cases.blocked_reason: TD3+BC is compatible with offline RL only.

cases.title: Offline behavior cloning in online RL is blocked
cases.description: Behavior cloning is offline-only and must be rejected by an online-RL experiment.
cases.blocked_reason: Behavior cloning is compatible with offline RL only.

cases.title: Unknown agent is blocked
cases.description: A method that names an unavailable agent must fail preflight.
cases.blocked_reason: Unknown agent names must not launch.

cases.title: Conflicting checkpoint schedules are blocked
cases.description: An online-RL experiment cannot set both checkpoint schedule fields.
cases.blocked_reason: Only one checkpoint schedule can be configured.

cases.title: Invalid checkpoint interval is blocked
cases.description: Checkpoint intervals must be positive whole numbers.
cases.blocked_reason: A zero transition interval is invalid.
cases.expected_error: must be a whole number of at least 1

cases.title: Malformed telemetry selection is blocked
cases.description: Telemetry metric selections must contain only non-empty strings.

components.name: ThetaLib Core Foundation Suite
components.description: Foundational library plugin for Theta-IDE: universal convergence/loss/report figures and core data loaders (image, replay buffer, tabular).
